text:
henry_pm: Quick flag from today's onboarding run: the in-product tip labels the feature 'Shortcuts' but Console nav/docs call it 'Routes'. New hires got confused. Also, help links open a modal that doesn't focus the section heading. Need a short plan to harmonize.

tara_design: Agreed we should standardize on one label. I prefer 'Routes' to match nav. Suggest we tighten the tip to a title + one-line blurb and add an "Open full docs" icon that opens in a new tab to avoid modal focus issues.

oliver_docs: I can run a sweep to replace remaining 'Shortcuts' pages and emit a redirects.json mapping legacy anchors to canonical slugs. I'll also add a small banner when a redirect occurs: "You were redirected from a legacy link."

mina_eng: For a fast patch I'll add a tiny client-side replace map ({"shortcuts":"routes"}) so the tip shows the canonical term immediately. I'll also implement a docs_redirect telemetry event when we remap an anchor. For the modal fix, we'll set role="dialog", aria-modal="true", and call focus() on the main heading after mount.

a11y-bot: a11y notes: ensure the modal focus lands on an H1/H2 and that there's a visible focus outline. Check contrast for tip text in dark mode (target >=4.5:1). Also ensure keyboard users can close the modal with Escape and that focus returns to the trigger.

henry_pm: Ownership confirmed: oliver_docs -> canonical sweep + redirects.json + banner; mina_eng -> client replace + telemetry + modal focus; tara_design -> tip microcopy + new-tab CTA + contrast. Can we get PRs by Thu and a small canary Friday? Please @me on PRs.

oliver_docs: Will open a draft PR with the redirects.json and a short migration note.

mina_eng: I'll add a feature flag for the client replace so we can roll back if needed and include the telemetry.

tara_design: I'll drop the updated microcopy and color tweaks into the PR.

henry_pm: Thanks everyone — small alignment but will reduce onboarding confusion. We'll review canary metrics next week. :+1:
